english: Grabbed
A Grabber has hold of you: you can't sprint or jump and you're 80% slower. Any hit on it, yours or a teammate's, breaks the hold.
Poisoned
A Toxic zombie's hit: 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.
Chilled
A Frostbitten zombie's hit: 20% slower and half stamina regeneration for 6 seconds. Stacks twice.
Nausea
A Bloater's bile cloud: blurred vision and 2 damage a second while you breathe it.
Bloater: swollen belly and pus sacs. It bursts into a bile cloud when it dies. Kill it at range, or with fire.
Sprinter: red veins, panting. Runs even by day, but doubles over after 8 seconds of running. Sidestep and punish it.
Spiked: bone spurs. Its hits make you bleed and hitting it up close scratches you. Clubs hurt it most; spears and guns are safe.
Grabber: huge gnarled hands. It can hold you for 2 seconds. Hit it, or have a teammate hit it, to break free.
Screecher: torn jaw, swollen throat. It shrieks the first time it sees you and every zombie near comes, then hangs back a few seconds before it joins in. Kill it before it sees you.
Frostbitten: frosted over, rimed with ice. Its hits chill you. It doesn't feel cold, but fire hurts it 50% more.
Smoldering: charred and glowing. Fire doesn't hurt it and its hits set you alight; it bursts into flame when it dies. Fight it at range.
Leaper: wiry, long claws. It leaps at you from 4 to 8 meters, and stumbles if it misses. Sidestep the leap.
Regenerator: pale fungus. It heals when you stop hitting it and slinks off to do it. Fire stops the healing and hurts it more.
Toxic: glowing green veins. Its hits poison you, and hitting it up close splashes you with acid. Use range.
Volatile: a propane tank on its chest. Shoot the chest or set it alight and the tank blows. A headshot kills it cleanly.
Hulking: huge and broad. Double health, knocks you back and charges, but never runs. Aim for the head, or cripple a leg to drop it.
Stalker: dark and silent. It creeps up while you're not looking and freezes when you are. Check behind you.
Brood: a writhing sac on its belly. Two crawlers burst out when it dies, unless fire or an explosion gets them.
Lurker: hunched, eyes that always catch the light. It only comes at you while you look away, and runs when you look at it. Once it reaches you, or anyone hits it, it fights.
Helmet: it soaks your headshots until it's knocked off. Blunt hits wear it down faster; armor-piercing rounds go through.
Kevlar vest: it takes half of every body hit until it breaks, and slows the zombie. Aim for the head or the limbs.
Scrap armor: plates wired on, front, back and shoulders, each breaking off on its own. Heavy: it slows the zombie down.
Champion: a named zombie with several mutations and triple health. It always drops a good loot bag.
The Blood Moon's Alpha: it holds back, then rallies the horde. Zombies near it are faster; when it falls, they stumble.
Possum: it played dead. It drops as if killed the first time, then gets up when you come close or turn your back. No XP when it falls means it isn't dead.
Snatcher: a sack on its back. It grabs what's in your hand and runs. Kill it before it gets away, or what it took is gone.
Shield: a car door or riot shield on its arm takes every hit from the front until it breaks. Go round it, or aim for the legs.
